title: PixelKin - Driftholm at Dawn (SNES register)
_note: Driftholm after the isles' dawn (flag:isles_dawn, the map's music_when). The SAME hymn as driftholm, note for note, turned MAJOR (F->F#, C->C#, Bb->B) and given the full band: 92 BPM, 3/4, D major. Lead pulse25 unchanged in shape; strings pad on the brighter chords (D G A F#m Bm...); pluck harp in rolling eighths; bell answers every phrase with a little counter-line; flute counter-melody under the second line and the bridge; tri_bass walking root-fifth-octave; a gentle festive kit (soft kick, hat, light snare, crash on each 8-bar downbeat, tom pickup into it). The bridge's relative turn is now B minor-ish colour inside D major. 32 bars, 62.6 s; the last bar's A pickup leads to bar 1. Original (VISION.md).
